products.name: Voicemod
products.note: Real-time voice changing; gaming/streaming; content moderation; EU vendor

profile_text.body:
Voicemod is a company that develops a real-time voice changing and soundboard application available for PC and Mac. The company describes itself as the leading real-time AI voice changer and soundboard, aimed at users in gaming, streaming, and social settings. Its software offers more than 200 voices and effects, and on devices running Snapdragon X Elite hardware, the application runs its AI voice workloads on the NPU for on-device processing with low latency.

The held facts identify Voicemod as an EU-based vendor whose product sits in the voice and audio category and includes content moderation functionality alongside its consumer-facing features. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are noted in the available data.
